tex_content.label: chap:pet-geodesics-and-distance
tex_content.html: This chapter defines mixed partials, geodesics, curve length, and Riemannian distance; proves the first variation formula, introduces exponential and normal coordinates, and records local isometry, completeness, cut-locus, and injectivity-radius results.
